name: sparx — Restaurant Equipment (B2B / Wholesale)
tagline: A wholesale storefront built for commercial kitchens.
description: A complete, working wholesale shop for a commercial kitchen & restaurant-equipment distributor: a real trade catalogue sold by the unit and the case — prep tables, cooking gear, food storage, front-of-house service and smallwares — with categories, collections, a bespoke trade PDP (per-unit/per-case pricing, volume breaks, net-30), and a full merchandised home page. Kitchen-grade theme — warm steel ground, deep graphite, an ember copper accent. Shipped as Pass Supply Co.
